Aumento crescente da repartição de resultados

title: Senior Go Engineer
description:
We are seeking to bring on board a Senior Go Engineer. You will be responsible for leading the development of web applications using Go. You’ll work on the back-end, focusing on delivering efficient, scalable, and robust solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, UI/UX designers, and other team members to ensure seamless integration between the front-end and back-end.
  • Build efficient, reusable, and scalable code while following best practices for security and performance.

  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, and Kubernetes for development and deployment.
  • Previous experience with high volume, high scale distributed systems.

title: Country Operations Manager
description:
Country Operations Manager – LATAM

Location: Brazil/ Remote

Job Type: Full-time contract



About Trantor Inc

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.



Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.



About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused, with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth. The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams, ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams, driving compliance and retention, and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.


What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.



Key Responsibilities


, HR & Resource Management

  • Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.


Tech Operations Oversight

  • Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams .
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers across LATAM.
  • Act as the primary liaison for client needs, service delivery, and customer success.
  • Represent the company at local and regional events, forums, and client meetings.


Operational Leadership & Strategic Growth

  • Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.
  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, and global teams for seamless cross-functional workflows.
  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.


Financial & Market Insight Contribution

  • Support budget planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Provide local market intelligence to inform global strategic decisions.



Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 8–12 years in senior leadership or country management, preferably in the IT/Consulting sector.
  • People & HR Management: Proven success in leading teams, driving workforce planning, employee engagement, HR processes, and HR compliance , with measurable improvement in retention.
  • Tech Operations Oversight: Demonstrated ability to set up, scale, and manage IT/Tech teams (Must Have)
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Strong track record in building trusted relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strategic & Operational Skills: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable operational and delivery plans, while ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; Spanish and Portuguese proficiency are strong advantages.
  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, business management platforms, and performance reporting tools.



Why Join Us?

  • Strategic leadership role with direct impact on our LATAM operations
  • Competitive remuneration (salary only)
  • Work within a global and fast-growing organization
  • Friendly, supportive, positive, and professional team of experts
  • Multicultural and diverse environment
  • Full-time employment
  • Remote work conditions

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End Java - Pleno | Azure Cloud, Kafka
description:

  • Conhecimento em Design Patterns;
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura de hexagonal de soluções;

title: Brazil -Front-end Developer
description:

Code samples are required.

Who We Are

Arke is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy that believes in providing more – much more. Arke’s core values are the soul of who we are and shape everything we do. We are authentically unique, operate with high standards, and love what we do.

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs


About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.


How to Apply


Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.
  • Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  • A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.


Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Build and manage GraphQL APIs and services with Apollo 
  • Develop scalable, secure backend systems integrated with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) 
  • Explore, implement, and optimize **AI/ML services, APIs, and cloud-based AI tools**  
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices  
  • Test, debug, and deploy applications for performance and reliability  
  • Collaborate with designers, product managers, and other developers to deliver features end-to-end

  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI/ML, evaluating new research, frameworks, and tools to enhance product capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guiding best practices throughout the ML lifecycle.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of professional experience designing, building, and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS for ML workflows (data pipelines, model training, deployment, and monitoring).
  • Expert proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.

  • Proven track record deploying ML systems into production and integrating them into real products or services at scale.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and MLOps best practices.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, or agentic AI systems.
  • Expertise in deep learning, NLP, time-series forecasting, or computer vision.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Amazon SageMaker for model lifecycle management.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or publications in the field.
  • Understanding of data engineering workflows, ETL pipelines, and real-time data processing


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

title: Azure Platform Engineer/ Architect
description:
Role Overview :


We are is seeking a hands-on Azure Platform Engineer/Architect with strong architectural knowledge of Azure PaaS services and DevOps skills. This person will work closely with backend engineers and automation teams to design, implement, and deploy cloud-native solutions on Azure. The role requires expertise in Azure services, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD pipelines, with the ability to troubleshoot and support PaaS solutions end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Collaborate with backend engineers to architect and deploy Azure PaaS solutions, including Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, ACR, APIM, and Application Gateway.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML-based pipelines) or GitHub Actions when required.
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, with the ability to deploy infrastructure manually if needed.
  • Provide hands-on troubleshooting of Azure environments, including debugging deployments, managing permissions (RBAC), and resolving issues with PaaS services.
  • Assist data scientists and AI engineers with containerization, API endpoints, and prototyping on Azure Machine Learning or related services.
  • Implement and enforce security gates (SonarQube, SCA, DAST, SAST) in CI/CD pipelines and ensure compliance with Azure policies and governance.
  • Optimize and monitor Azure environments using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Support and improve operational automation (PowerShell, Python) and cost optimization initiatives (tagging, right-sizing).
  • Collaborate with teams to build solutions that run entirely on Azure PaaS, ensuring performance and scalability.

Required Skills :

  • Strong experience with Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, ACR, and APIM.
  • Hands-on expertise with Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Proficiency in Azure DevOps Services (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts) and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for Azure PaaS services and deployment issues.
  • Experience with blue-green, canary, and rolling deployment strategies.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance practices in Azure (Azure Policy, RBAC, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud).
  • Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation.
  • Familiarity with Azure cost management and resource optimization.
  • Excellent communication skills to guide and support development and data science teams.

title: Senior UI Designer - Part time
description:

Type: On-Demand / Part time Placement (Long-term, multi-year engagement possible)


Overview

We are seeking an experienced UI Designer to join our design team in an on-demand capacity. This position supports overflow project work, ad hoc design needs, and team coverage during PTO. While the work will vary depending on client and project demands, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to strategic, high-impact design initiatives.

This is not a freelance, flexible-hour role, candidates must be available full-time during EST working hours to collaborate with internal and client teams, attend meetings, and deliver design solutions as needed. Open to be worked remotely in any south American country


Key Responsibilities

  • Support active design projects as needed during staff PTO and overflow periods.
  • Mentor and guide other UI Designers.
  • Define and implement visual direction for project rollouts.
  • Develop and maintain design systems and style guides.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles with clients and stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the strategic vision of the user experience.
  • Lead design reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Participate in project planning and scoping activities.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and developer specifications.
  • Conduct user research and analyze user feedback.
  • Ensure designs are accessible and adhere to WCAG and usability standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on project goals and timelines.
  • Communicate design decisions effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Follow Curio’s Figma Etiquette for all design files.
  • Maintain design consistency across products and platforms.
  • Stay current with Apple HIG, Google Material, and Web Design Best Practices.


Typical Tasks

  • Design support for Proof of Concepts (POCs) and RFPs.
  • Contribution to case studies and internal initiatives.
  • Long-term design maintenance and system updates.


Required Skills

Primary Skills

  • Expertise in Figma (including advanced component systems).
  • Strong understanding of Apple HIG, Google Material Design, and web design best practices.
  • Knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Skilled in design presentation and client communication.

Secondary Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Animation and motion design.
  • Video editing and print design.
  • 3D modeling, AI/AR/VR experience.
  • User research and usability testing.
  • Webflow or front-end development experience.

Soft Skills

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Highly proactive and self-motivated.
  • Naturally inquisitive – asks “why” to understand user and business goals.
  • Clear, concise communication (no tangents or offshoots).
  • Confident and independent decision-making ability.


Qualifications

  • Strong portfolios and hands-on experience will be prioritized.
  • Must provide an online portfolio and Figma samples for team review.


Professional Development

  • Annual review of Apple HIG, Google Material, and Web Best Practices.
  • Ongoing skill development through Figma training and cross-disciplinary collaboration.

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)


  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards


  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.


  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.


What You’ll Achieve

You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join the Prosigliere team.


Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of data warehousing principles, ETL processes, and database management, with a strong focus on ensuring data quality, accessibility, and performance to support our analytical and reporting needs. You will play a critical role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, empowering our data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines using various data integration techniques to ingest, transform, and load data from diverse sources into our data warehouse.
  • Manage and optimize data models and structures within Snowflake, ensuring strategic organization for performance, cost-efficiency, and ease of consumption by analytics and reporting tools.
  • Administer and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Develop, monitor, and troubleshoot data workflows and orchestrations using Apache Airflow to ensure timely and reliable data delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency by implementing robust data validation, cleansing, and monitoring processes.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing Tableau reports, and develop new, insightful dashboards and visualizations to meet business needs.
  • Implement and maintain data governance best practices, including data security, privacy, and compliance.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to architectural discussions, and promote best practices in data engineering.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform and processes.


Technology Requirements

  • Databases: Strong expertise in PostgreSQL and extensive experience with Snowflake data warehousing.
  • Orchestration: Proficient in using Apache Airflow for workflow management and scheduling.
  • ETL/ELT: Proven experience in designing and implementing efficient ETL/ELT processes.
  • Business Intelligence: Hands-on experience with Tableau for report troubleshooting and development.
  • Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, scripting, and automation.
  • Cloud Platforms: Experience with at least one major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their data-related services (e.g., S3, EC2, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery).
  • Data Concepts: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, data lakes, and data marts.
  • Version Control: Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • SQL: Advanced SQL writing and optimization skills.
  • Big Data Technologies (Plus): Familiarity with big data technologies like Spark, Kafka, or similar is a plus.


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.

We are seeking an experienced SAP PPDS Consultant to join our team.   • Experience in CIF integration between SAP ECC/S4HANA and PPDS.
  • Solid understanding of production planning processes , including Make-to-Order (MTO), Make-to-Stock (MTS), and Repetitive Manufacturing .
  • Hands-on experience in heuristics, capacity leveling, and scheduling strategies .
  • Strong knowledge of SAP PP/MM and integration with EWM .
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software



ABOUT DE-YAN

DE-YAN is a brand experience studio built to lead the next era of human connection.

We seamlessly fuse creative development, in-house production, and immersive storytelling to create authentic, human-first moments – moments that are proven to build a powerful relationship between brands and their audiences.


With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Experiência com Java

Experiência com React

Participar da execução de testes

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Game Producer (Mid to Senior, Full Cycle)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (strong professional working proficiency) 

Salary Range: R$8K – R$12.5K 

762 Interactive is looking for an experienced Game Producer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong production instincts, excellent communication skills, and a passion for bringing teams together to deliver high-quality, player-focused experiences. 

You’ll coordinate across design, development, and art to drive milestones, organize workflows, and keep the team aligned from prototype to launch. This role requires both hands-on project management and the ability to think strategically about the production process as we scale the studio. 

This is a remote position. 

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.   


In this Role You Will:

  • Manage full-cycle production, from prototype to full release, ensuring milestones are clear, realistic, and achieved. 
  • Build and maintain production schedules, roadmaps, and task boards. Work with discipline leads to determine the time and resources needed to complete projects.  
  • Coordinate day-to-day workflows between design, art, and engineering teams. 
  • Track progress, anticipate risks, and adjust priorities to keep projects on track. 
  • Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
  • Communicate project status clearly to leadership. 
  • Help define production processes and best practices as part of a growing studio. Ensure the team has what they need to produce high-quality work efficiently and on time. 
  • Foster a collaborative, transparent, and solution-oriented team culture. 


What We're Looking For:

  • 4+ years of professional experience as a Game Producer in game development. 
  • Proven experience managing cross-disciplinary teams (art, design, programming). 
  • Strong understanding of game development lifecycles and production pipelines. 
  • Experience working in Agile production environments. 
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Monday/Jira, Miro, Notion, Trello, etc.). 
  • Excellent organization, communication, and leadership skills. 
  • Ability to identify bottlenecks and proactively solve problems. 
  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership over deliverables. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; strong professional English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership. 


Nice to Have:

  • Experience shipping games from prototype to launch. 
  • Background or passion for game design, systems, or gameplay mechanics. 
  • Familiarity with Unity and general development tools. 
  • Interest in strategy / simulation / management games. 


What We Offer :

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT contract with benefits (Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Stipend, Monthly Internet / Home Office Stipend) 
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: GenAI Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Software Engineer focused on Artificial Intelligence, you will make a significant contribution to the construction of innovative AI Agents by collaborating closely with your engineering peers. This role requires a high degree of creative thinking and a strong willingness to learn, as you will be working with the latest in Generative AI tools and frameworks. The Agentic AI Engineer explores emerging technologies, promotes new development approaches, and helps shape the standards for intelligent automation, playing a fundamental role in advancing the company's AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of autonomous AI Agents, leveraging LLMs, advanced techniques such as RAG, and agent-specific frameworks;
  • Develop full-stack applications that support and interact with AI Agents, using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Next.js to build the necessary interfaces and systems;
  • Explore and experiment with emerging technologies and frameworks in the agentic space, fostering innovation and shaping best practices;
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to define the behavior, capabilities, and goals of AI Agents, translating business requirements into robust agentic solutions;
  • Ensure code quality through rigorous reviews, testing, and documentation, while mentoring other engineers on development best practices.


Essential Skills

  • Solid experience in software engineering, with proven expertise in writing clean, maintainable code and leveraging modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure quality and automate delivery;
  • Hands-on and up-to-date knowledge of Generative AI, including experience building and implementing features with LLMs in real-world products;
  • Strong foundation in software engineering principles, including system design, API architecture, code quality, and testing.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience in designing GenAI solutions architecture, agent frameworks, and advanced techniques such as RAG;
  • Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) applied to production-grade systems;
  • Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, including proficiency with modern frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI for the purpose of building, testing, and deploying autonomous, goal-oriented agents.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (


Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 8 to 12 years of software programming experience, including a strong background in Golang, Kubernetes, major cloud platforms, and CI/CD. You will fully automate provisioning, deployment, management, and monitoring for a rapidly evolving and highly scalable set of SaaS services. You will work with members of the DevOps team alongside a DevOps architect to ensure best practices are implemented across applications, lead teams in the direction of initiatives, such as CI/CD and enterprise monitoring, and work on support services operational on the cloud.

You are the ideal candidate if you enjoy improving engineering efficiency, mentoring junior team members, promoting best practices, and solving problems by digging into the technical details.

Our client was named a Top 25 Cybersecurity Company by The Software Report and one of Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work in 2020. The company is a leader in cloud-based networking and security services. Their services empower organizations to optimize cloud usage, delivering network experiences that are simple, scalable, and reliable. The client counts 70% of the Fortune 500 companies as customers.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, design, and maintain features that empower developer productivity
  • Design and implement components of the client's next-generation, internal developer platform
  • Recommend ways to improve system reliability, efficiency, and quality
  • Work closely with various cross-functional product teams
  • Stay up-to-date on key trends, especially in the area of technologies and frameworks like Kubernetes, Docker, ELK/Prometheus, and more
  • Own platform engineering
  • Develop REST APIs and contribute to the overall API framework
  • Use multiple open software to build a developer platform


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8 to 12 years of experience in software development using programming languages
  • Experience with Golang, including building API and web services
  • Experience with DevOps technologies and methodologies, including Kubernetes, major cloud platforms (preferably AWS), and CI/CD
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture and container-based software, such as Docker
  • Experience developing microservices and using Cloud Services API
  • Strong focus on reliability and security
  • Solid exposure to application performance tuning, memory management, and scalability
  • Ability to design highly scalable distributed systems using different open-source technologies


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent educational experience (preferably in a STEM field)
  • Additional container technologies besides Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services, such as EC2, VPC, ELB, S3, and CloudFormation, or equivalent services in GCP and/or Azure


Additional Info

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter – think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual – no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

Please submit your application through LinkedIn with your resume in English .

Applications that are not in English will not be reviewed...because the reviewer only speaks English. ;)

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold’s Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.


Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold’s Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

title: Project Engineer

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance


Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.


We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects.   • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus


Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems

Agora queremos te contar mais sobre a vaga de Analista de Legalização na área de Legalização e como você pode construir o futuro junto com a gente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Garantir a emissão das licenças, aprovações e documentos técnicos necessários para a aquisição de terrenos, lançamento dos empreendimentos e execução das obras, baseando-se na legislação urbanística e ambiental vigentes, observando a validade e o cumprimento de restrições, identificando e mitigando os possíveis riscos, a fim de trazer segurança à companhia. Acompanhamento do andamento das obras, com visitas regulares às obras e órgão públicos para garantir a emissão do habite-se e demais aceitações necessárias à entrega do empreendimento.


  • Analisar os terrenos do ponto de vista e fornecer as diretrizes para desenvolvimento dos projetos arquitetônicos.
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos de Legalização para o projeto, com fins de apresentação em Comitê interno de avaliação do negócio, levantando todos os pontos de atenção e/ou riscos incidentes na área no que diz respeito à legislação urbanística e ambiental vigente e as licenças necessárias/ emitidas.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronograma de licenciamento para lançamento do empreendimento, avaliando os desvios entre previsto e realizado e propondo planos de ações para manter o prazo final.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar orçamento de custos da área para cada empreendimento/projeto, avaliando os desvios entre previsto e realizado e possíveis impactos na viabilidade do negócio como um todo.
  • Garantir execução dos serviços de supressão de vegetação antes da data prevista para o início das obras.
  • Participar em Auditorias internas e externas como responsável pela área de Legalização.
  • Subsidiar com informações e documentação técnica-legal dos empreendimentos já entregues para as demais áreas da Companhia que lidam com a pós-entrega (Gerência de Assistência Pós Entrega-GAPE, Relacionamento com Cliente-CRM, Jurídico Contencioso, Ciclo Financeiro etc).
  • Liberar e acompanhar elaboração dos projetos técnicos complementares (EP - Estudo Preliminar) das diversas disciplinas para aprovação dos mesmos, quando necessário, e/ou apresentação dos mesmos em outros processos de licenciamento
  • Articular e participar de reuniões estratégicas com os técnicos dos órgãos públicos.
  • Apresentar o empreendimento para a equipe de Operações que irá executar a obra, apresentando as licenças emitidas e em fase de emissão, levantando os pontos de atenção e auxiliando na emissão de autorizações e aceites necessários à execução e entrega das obras
  • Subsidiar o coordenador com as informações da área de Legalização necessárias à elaboração do BP - Business Plan (Plano de Negócios) anual que define prazos, custos e metas dos Lançamentos da Companhia.

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ensino superior completo em Arquitetura ou Engenharia Civil;
  • Experiência com licenciamento, regularização e trâmites junto a prefeituras e órgãos públicos;
  • Habilidade em leitura e interpretação de projetos em AutoCad;

title: Software Engineer Sênior

O que nós estamos procurando;

  • Analisar e identificar possíveis riscos ao projeto, auxiliando na identificação de estratégias de prevenção e diminuição dos mesmos e reavaliando desde o inicio até o final;
  • Planejar, monitorar, administrar os projetos , analisando as documentações pertinentes , garantindo que as obrigações contratuais relativas às especificações, qualidade, custos e prazos sejam atendidas;

title: Gerente Operacional – Acoem Ambiental (Belford Roxo – RJ)

O Gerente Operacional será responsável pela gestão integral da unidade de Belford Roxo , assegurando a excelência operacional, o cumprimento de metas financeiras e o alinhamento estratégico com os objetivos da Acoem Brasil e do Grupo Acoem.

Reportará diretamente ao Diretor Executivo da Acoem Brasil, desempenhando papel-chave no crescimento, rentabilidade e sustentabilidade da operação .


Principais responsabilidades

Gestão estratégica e execução operacional

  • Definir e implementar a estratégia operacional da unidade, alinhada à visão e aos objetivos da Acoem Brasil.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos (OTD – On Time Delivery), padrões de qualidade e metas financeiras.
  • Supervisionar e integrar as áreas de Produção, Logística, Estoque, Compras, Administrativo e Financeiro, otimizando fluxos de trabalho e recursos.

Performance financeira e orçamentária

  • Elaborar e gerenciar o orçamento anual, assegurando controle rigoroso de custos e maximização da rentabilidade.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros e operacionais, implementando ações corretivas e de melhoria contínua.
  • Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos sem comprometer qualidade e prazos.

Qualidade, compliance e melhoria contínua

  • Garantir conformidade com todas as normas legais, regulatórias e padrões de qualidade aplicáveis ao setor ambiental.
  • Implantar e manter sistemas robustos de gestão da qualidade.
  • Promover cultura de melhoria contínua e inovação em processos e serviços.

Liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes

  • Inspirar, desenvolver e reter talentos, promovendo engajamento e alta performance.
  • Fomentar um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, com autonomia, responsabilidade e foco em resultados.
  • Garantir que as equipes estejam capacitadas nas tecnologias e padrões do Grupo Acoem.

Relacionamento com clientes e mercado

  • Atuar como representante estratégico junto a clientes, parceiros e órgãos reguladores.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em posição de liderança operacional em empresas de bens de capital, serviços técnicos ou monitoramento ambiental.

  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com matriz e parceiros internacionais.

  • Facilidade de acesso a Belford Roxo – RJ.

Diferenciais

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


1. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of

our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance,

reliability, and scalability.

2. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and

support business processes

3. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal

and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare

systems and third-party services.

4. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare

industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining

robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


1. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in

backend development, code review, and team collaboration.

2. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to

continually innovate and enhance the platform.

3. Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint

planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of

high-quality software.

4. Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface

and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end

functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:


1. Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL.

Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a

proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

highly desirable.

3. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think

analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

4. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills,

capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and

stakeholders.

5. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design

specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and

efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth


Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Júnior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


#Requisitos e qualificações:

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.
